query.description: Para Setup 대표 Chain 탭: 단자 목록 (Sub Device 등록 Parameter 의 단자 1 / 2 + 대표 Chain, 대표 Chain 에만 남은 단자 포함)
query.commandtext: WITH D AS (SELECT UPPER(SUB_DEVICE_ID) AS DEVICE_KEY FROM TQP_GDS_MAP_SUB_DEVICE WHERE FACTORY = :f1 AND DEVICE_ID = :g1 UNION SELECT UPPER(:g2) FROM DUAL), T AS (SELECT I.FACTORY, I.DEVICE_ID, I.TEST_PROGRAM, I.ITEM_NAME, I.HEADER_TEXT, I.ET_ITEM_SEQ, I.CHAIN_TYPE, I.CHAIN_NAME AS TERMINAL_NAME, I.FORCE_LEG AS FORCE_LEG FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I WHERE I.FACTORY = :f2 AND I.TEST_PROGRAM IS NOT NULL AND I.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND UPPER(I.DEVICE_ID) IN (SELECT DEVICE_KEY FROM D) UNION ALL SELECT I.FACTORY, I.DEVICE_ID, I.TEST_PROGRAM, I.ITEM_NAME, I.HEADER_TEXT, I.ET_ITEM_SEQ, I.CHAIN_TYPE, I.CHAIN_NAME2, I.FORCE_LEG2 FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I WHERE I.FACTORY = :f3 AND I.TEST_PROGRAM IS NOT NULL AND I.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.CHAIN_NAME2 IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(I.DEVICE_ID) IN (SELECT DEVICE_KEY FROM D)), P AS (SELECT TERMINAL_NAME, LISTAGG(TEST_PROGRAM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TEST_PROGRAM) AS TEST_PROGRAMS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TERMINAL_NAME, TEST_PROGRAM FROM T) GROUP BY TERMINAL_NAME), A AS (SELECT T.TERMINAL_NAME, MAX(T.FORCE_LEG) AS FORCE_LEG, MAX(T.CHAIN_TYPE) AS CHAIN_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT T.ET_ITEM_SEQ) AS PARA_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SN.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL OR SO.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN T.ET_ITEM_SEQ END) AS SPEC_COUNT FROM T LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT SN ON SN.FACTORY = T.FACTORY AND SN.DEVICE_ID = T.DEVICE_ID AND SN.TEST_PROGRAM = T.TEST_PROGRAM AND SN.ITEM_NAME = T.ITEM_NAME LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT SO ON SO.FACTORY = T.FACTORY AND SO.DEVICE_ID = T.DEVICE_ID AND SO.TEST_PROGRAM = T.TEST_PROGRAM AND SO.ITEM_NAME = UPPER(T.HEADER_TEXT) GROUP BY T.TERMINAL_NAME), R AS (SELECT TERMINAL_NAME, REP_CHAIN_NAME, REMARK, NVL(UPDATE_USER, CREATE_USER) AS UPDATE_USER, NVL(UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_TIME) AS UPDATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_ET_REP_CHAIN WHERE FACTORY = :f4 AND DEVICE_ID = :g3) SELECT NVL(A.TERMINAL_NAME, R.TERMINAL_NAME) AS TERMINAL_NAME, A.FORCE_LEG, A.CHAIN_TYPE, P.TEST_PROGRAMS, NVL(A.PARA_COUNT, 0) AS PARA_COUNT, NVL(A.SPEC_COUNT, 0) AS SPEC_COUNT, R.REP_CHAIN_NAME, R.REMARK, R.UPDATE_USER, R.UPDATE_TIME FROM A FULL OUTER JOIN R ON R.TERMINAL_NAME = A.TERMINAL_NAME LEFT JOIN P ON P.TERMINAL_NAME = A.TERMINAL_NAME ORDER BY NVL(A.TERMINAL_NAME, R.TERMINAL_NAME)

query.description: GDS 대표 Device 의 대표 Chain 구성 단자 전체
query.commandtext: SELECT TERMINAL_NAME, REP_CHAIN_NAME, REMARK, NVL(UPDATE_USER, CREATE_USER) AS UPDATE_USER, NVL(UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_TIME) AS UPDATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_ET_REP_CHAIN WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id ORDER BY REP_CHAIN_NAME, TERMINAL_NAME

query.description: GDS 대표 Device 의 Setup Chain (ACTIVE + 현재 READY 버전)
query.commandtext: SELECT C.CHAIN_SEQ, C.CHAIN_CODE, V.CHAIN_NAME FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN C JOIN TQP_GDS_CHAIN_VER V ON V.FACTORY = C.FACTORY AND V.DEVICE_ID = C.DEVICE_ID AND V.CHAIN_SEQ = C.CHAIN_SEQ AND V.IS_CURRENT = 1 WHERE C.FACTORY = :factory AND C.DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND C.CHAIN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND V.VERSION_STATUS = 'READY' ORDER BY V.CHAIN_NAME, C.CHAIN_CODE

query.description: 대표 Chain 의 단자가 단자 1 / 2 로 들어간 모든 공정 등록 Parameter + Spec
query.commandtext: WITH D AS (SELECT UPPER(SUB_DEVICE_ID) AS DEVICE_KEY FROM TQP_GDS_MAP_SUB_DEVICE WHERE FACTORY = :f1 AND DEVICE_ID = :g1 UNION SELECT UPPER(:g2) FROM DUAL), M AS (SELECT TERMINAL_NAME FROM TQP_GDS_ET_REP_CHAIN WHERE FACTORY = :f2 AND DEVICE_ID = :g3 AND REP_CHAIN_NAME = :rep_chain_name) SELECT I.DEVICE_ID, I.TEST_PROGRAM, I.ITEM_NAME, I.HEADER_TEXT, I.CHAIN_NAME, I.CHAIN_NAME2, CASE WHEN M1.TERMINAL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND M2.TERMINAL_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN '1,2' WHEN M1.TERMINAL_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS MATCH_POSITION, I.UNIT, I.USE_FLAG, CASE WHEN SN.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL OR SO.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HAS_SPEC, CASE WHEN SN.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN SN.LOWER_LIMIT ELSE SO.LOWER_LIMIT END AS LOWER_LIMIT, CASE WHEN SN.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN SN.UPPER_LIMIT ELSE SO.UPPER_LIMIT END AS UPPER_LIMIT, CASE WHEN SN.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN SN.ENABLE_FLAG ELSE SO.ENABLE_FLAG END AS ENABLE_FLAG, CASE WHEN SN.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN SN.SPEC_TEXT ELSE SO.SPEC_TEXT END AS SPEC_TEXT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I LEFT JOIN M M1 ON M1.TERMINAL_NAME = I.CHAIN_NAME LEFT JOIN M M2 ON M2.TERMINAL_NAME = I.CHAIN_NAME2 LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT SN ON SN.FACTORY = I.FACTORY AND SN.DEVICE_ID = I.DEVICE_ID AND SN.TEST_PROGRAM = I.TEST_PROGRAM AND SN.ITEM_NAME = I.ITEM_NAME LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT SO ON SO.FACTORY = I.FACTORY AND SO.DEVICE_ID = I.DEVICE_ID AND SO.TEST_PROGRAM = I.TEST_PROGRAM AND SO.ITEM_NAME = UPPER(I.HEADER_TEXT) WHERE I.FACTORY = :f3 AND I.TEST_PROGRAM IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(I.DEVICE_ID) IN (SELECT DEVICE_KEY FROM D) AND (M1.TERMINAL_NAME IS NOT NULL OR M2.TERMINAL_NAME IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY I.TEST_PROGRAM, I.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.ITEM_NAME

query.description: 단자를 대표 Chain 에 넣는다 (다른 대표에 있으면 옮김, InsertExecuteMultiple)
query.commandtext: MERGE INTO TQP_GDS_ET_REP_CHAIN T USING (SELECT :factory AS FACTORY, :device_id AS DEVICE_ID, :terminal_name AS TERMINAL_NAME, :rep_chain_name AS REP_CHAIN_NAME, :update_user AS UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL) S ON (T.FACTORY = S.FACTORY AND T.DEVICE_ID = S.DEVICE_ID AND T.TERMINAL_NAME = S.TERMINAL_NAME) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.REP_CHAIN_NAME = S.REP_CHAIN_NAME, T.UPDATE_USER = S.UPDATE_USER, T.UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, TERMINAL_NAME, REP_CHAIN_NAME, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (S.FACTORY, S.DEVICE_ID, S.TERMINAL_NAME, S.REP_CHAIN_NAME, S.UPDATE_USER, SYSDATE, S.UPDATE_USER, SYSDATE)

query.description: 대표 Chain 이름 바꾸기 (구성 단자 전체)
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_ET_REP_CHAIN SET REP_CHAIN_NAME = :new_name, UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND REP_CHAIN_NAME = :old_name
DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_ET_REP_CHAIN WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND TERMINAL_NAME = :terminal_name
DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_ET_REP_CHAIN WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND REP_CHAIN_NAME = :rep_chain_name
